newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-POPESCU QUITS BARCELONA FOR GALATASARAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POPESCU QUITS BARCELONA FOR GALATASARAY.

text.p: Romanian international midfielder Gheorghe Popescu, who captained Barcelona to victory in the European Cup Winners' Cup Final in May, has signed for Turkish league champions Galatasaray, the club said on Friday.
Popescu, who will be 30 in October, has reportedly signed a hugely lucrative three-year deal worth a reported $4.5 million, the Yeni Yuzyil newspaper said.
"Galatasaray have great ambitions. These ambitions are realised with great players and Popescu is one of those great players," Galatasaray coach Fatih Terim said.

Popescu, who has previously played for Steaua Bucharest, Universitatea Craiova, PSV Eindhoven and Tottenham Hotspur, joins fellow Romanians Gheorghe Hagi, Iulian Filipescu and Adrian Ilie at the Istanbul club.
Galatasaray, along with Besiktas, are in the expanded European Cup next season.
